system.description:
Cursed item (seems a Stone of Good Luck). While you carry it, your speed is halved and you have Disadvantage on Reflex saves. Thrown away, it is back in your pack by morning.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
system.unidentifiedDescription:
A luckstone. Your Luck score is +1 while you carry it, and once per day you may reroll a failed Luck Check.

Rarity: Uncommon
